description: Na₃SiTe₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five Te atoms. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.12-3.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Te atoms. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.18-3.59 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Te atoms. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.18-3.56 Å. Si is bonded to one Si and three Te atoms to form SiSiTe₃ tetrahedra that share corners with two TeNa₆Si pentagonal bipyramids. The Si-Si bond length is 2.38 Å. There is one shorter (2.53 Å) and two longer (2.54 Å) Si-Te bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Te sites. In the first Te site, Te is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Si atom. In the second Te site, Te is bonded to six Na and one Si atom to form distorted TeNa₆Si pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with five TeNa₆Si pentagonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one SiSiTe₃ tetrahedra, edges with four TeNa₆Si pentagonal bipyramids, and faces with two equivalent TeNa₆Si pentagonal bipyramids. In the third Te site, Te is bonded to six Na and one Si atom to form distorted TeNa₆Si pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent TeNa₆Si pentagonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one SiSiTe₃ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent TeNa₆Si pentagonal bipyramids, and faces with four TeNa₆Si pentagonal bipyramids.
